item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Vegetable omelette topped with chives and tomato. Served with summer salad plus beetroot and mustard on the side.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Potatoes alla cacciatore with pasta and sautéed spinach. Served with garlic croutons and green salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: GREEN DISH: vegetarian cheeseburger with kidney bean patty, chipotle mayo, tomato and pickled red onions. (1+6+8+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Rigatoni with roasted mushrooms, walnuts, baked red onion and radicchio. Sprinkled with flakes of wonderful Danish Vesterhavsost cheese and an intense kiss of balsamic.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Big Dabeli burger, juicy potato and vegetable pakora in a homemade bun with crispy namkeen and mint sauce. Served with kachumber salad with roasted peanuts, tamarind chutney and chilli sauce. Also available gluten-free and vegan. (1+4+6+15)
